# Koshirai researcher agent guide

README.md owns the public pipeline explanation. benchmarks/README.md owns counting
rules, reproducibility and measured evidence. This is the agent entry point.

The core result is raw OCR/general meanings, complete identified sequences,
sword-specific meanings with library citations, and closest supported alternatives.
An attested PrimaryReference or SupportingReference sequence-to-English mapping is source evidence.
The same sequence in Fujishiro supports that sword meaning, subject to context and conflicts.
Qwen vision only distinguishes visible strokes and similar character shapes.
It must not perform semantic reasoning, translation, term selection, or identity resolution.

[1. Source scan]
        ↓
[2. Regions, titles, chapters and oshigata links]
        ↓
[3. Reading order and raw kanji from NDLOCR]
        ↓
[4. Group characters with the sword/name library]
        ↓
[5. Select supported Japanese meanings and clause relationships]
        ↓
[6. Cited English presentation and reviewed corrections]

OCR extracts characters, not their English meaning. Vertical Japanese reads top
to bottom within a column and right to left between columns; horizontal segments
are separate. Headings, sections, captions and figure boundaries constrain joins.
Unknown chapters and uncertain figure associations must remain explicit.

Match complete supported library spans with literal offsets and boxes. Preserve
printed historical forms while normalizing lookup. 雲次 can support the smith name
Unji; 雲 alone cannot. Context selects supported meanings and preserves alternatives.
徳川 alone supports Tokugawa as a family name, not a specific historical person.

The contextual selector now handles cited multi-character technical terms inside
Japanese prose. Inspect each candidate's boundary evidence and complete_candidate
when a larger compound is withheld. Do not apply a smaller term's English to an
unmapped whole. Bilingual facts retain distinct edition/page hashes and provisional
image review. Two editions of one work do not supply independent votes.
The library_ocr input reads an explicit hash-bound saved export without new OCR.
It preserves raw lines, polygons, engine and corrected/ordered fields separately.
See docs/researcher_guide.md for its input contract.

Keep Japanese as the authoritative parsing language. entry_structure.py owns explicit
headings and bracketed era/province fields. japanese_clauses.py owns bounded relation
proposals with polarity and modality. interpretations.jsonl retains those units.
English summaries follow supported native argument/predicate selection; unsupported
wording remains visible. Do not pivot through a whole-page English translation.
The optional frontier_semantics.py experiment compares Astra and Sol on identical
inputs; live model evaluation is pending. See docs/native_semantics.md.
Preserve both legacy area-overlap and native_line_projection_v1 scores. The geometry
repair is explicit, applies to both comparison sides and never changes references.

PrimaryReference leads technical sword meanings. Club registers, SupportingReference and named scholarly
sources support smiths and relationships; dealer records are attributed supplements.
Keep technical terms, smiths/artisans, schools, sword traditions, measurements, historical people,
clans, places/provinces, eras/dates, ordinary language and unresolved spans distinct.
Retain measurement quantities/units and supported dimension links. Cite the actual
source for each assertion; repeated dealer records are not independent evidence.

NDLOCR owns literal recognition; layout logic owns order and relations; the span
matcher proposes supported groupings; source evidence ranks supported
category/reading/meaning candidates. Unvalidated vision and translation adapters
are retired; explicit source-reviewed character corrections remain separate.
Similarity retrieval narrows candidates and cannot establish characters or identity.
The optional bert profile uses a pinned Japanese BERT encoder and trained role head.
It selects supported roles or abstains. Preserve competing readings and meanings.
Do not call model scores measured correctness probabilities, AI labels expert truth,
or lookup rules a trained model. No paid inference starts by default.

Install: sh setup.sh --install-ocr; add --install-bert for the optional classifier.
CLI: the printed executable accepts scan INPUT --semantic-profile contextual --output OUTPUT.
Data: KANJI_DATA_DIR, default ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/kanji-translator.
Inputs, outputs, environments, models and dictionaries stay outside the checkout.
Evaluate: python3 -B benchmarks/evaluate_semantics.py --manifest MANIFEST
--config CONFIG --output /external/evaluation; add --references REFERENCES
--score-only after independent reference freeze. Inference runs in parse/scan.

One application lives in kanji_translator/. Starting owners: document_parser.py
(routing); image_regions.py and document_layout.py (structure); readers/ocr/ndlocr_lite.py
(literal OCR); semantic_groups.py (grouping/interpretation); region_enrichment.py (lexical cache); scan_folder.py and research_corpus.py
(scan/import). Consolidate these owners as needed; do not create competing routes.

Benchmark grouped mentions per page/category, including false positives and misses.
benchmarks/README.md defines counting rules, source-exclusive splits, ten smoke frames and 50 declared test regions,
three baselines, label origins and supporting relation/OCR measures. Historical
selected-target and character-rewrite scores are not this benchmark. Keep compact
unique negative evidence; never invent exhaustive labels or wins.

Preserve source hashes, original OCR, unique human corrections and accepted receipts.
Corpus import must be idempotent and separate human review from proposals. Accepted
source acquisition remains terminal. Private originals, credentials and private URLs
never enter a release. Public samples require documented reuse rights.

Cardinal rule: every file needs a current runtime, installation, verification,
reproducibility, rights or unique-evidence purpose. Human steering replaces old
methods and backlog. Verify successor/callers, then delete superseded executable
routes, models, configuration, tests and duplicate instructions. Do not keep a failed
method as an optional legacy mode. Preserve necessary historical evidence compactly;
keep published history intact and scan all reachable commits before publication.

Run appropriate behavior/install/publication checks and one file-purpose inventory.
Use the installed Python environment. Stop auditing after acceptance succeeds.
